text.arabic_uthmani: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

words.gloss_range: opening negation particle that scopes over the first imperfect wanting clause and begins the repeated denial frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: imperfect verb of wanting under negation

words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:ma}}) opens the ayah by placing the first wanting clause inside negation before the object is named. With the imperfect {{ar:أُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:uridu}}), the denial reads as an ongoing stance, not a one-time refusal. Its return at {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:ma}}) later in the ayah makes negation the frame of both halves: first no provision is wanted from them, then no feeding scenario is wanted from them. The repeated long opening sound also helps the two denials be heard as a paired structure rather than as loose assertions.

topics.headline: first negation scope
topics.summary: The opening particle scopes over the first imperfect wanting clause and its provision object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse begins by denying an ongoing divine will for any provisioning relation, not by asking a question or refusing one item.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a negation particle before the imperfect verb, and the attachment evidence marks the first clause as a negated wanting clause ending at the provision noun.

topics.headline: double negation frame
topics.summary: The first negator anticipates its reprise in the second coordinated clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah as a patterned denial covering provision as product and feeding as process.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence coordinates two verbal clauses headed by the same negated wanting frame, so the repetition structures the ayah.

topics.headline: matched negation cadence
topics.summary: The long opening sound recurs in both negated beats.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two denials as matched beats before parsing their different complements.
topics.reason: The ayah visibly begins with the negator and later repeats it in the coordinated second clause.

words.gloss_range: first-person imperfect Form IV wanting or willing under negation, directed here toward a rejected source-and-provision relation
words.root_gloss_range: will, intention, directed seeking, and pursuit-related pressure; local Form IV selects volition while broader solicitation or motion branches remain background only
words.prose: {{ar:أُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:uridu}}) carries the divine first person in the verb itself, so the clause keeps the speaker present without adding a separate subject noun. Under the opening negator, the imperfect form denies an ongoing will, and its complement frame gives that will a precise rejected direction: from {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) toward any {{ar:رِزْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:rizqin}}). The {{ar:ر و د}} ({{tr:r-w-d}}) family can carry pursuit pressure, but local Form IV selects willing and intending; that makes the payoff sharper, because the ayah denies even the initiating volition that would move toward created provision. The same verb returns at word 8, making negated divine volition the backbone of both halves while the complements change from product to feeding scenario.

topics.headline: first-person ongoing volition
topics.summary: The imperfect Form IV verb encodes the divine speaker and states continuing negated will.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices direct divine self-speech denying an ongoing state of wanting, not a remote report or past refusal.
topics.reason: QAC and implicit-argument evidence identify the verb as first-person singular imperfect under negation.

topics.headline: source and provision frame
topics.summary: The verb is filled by a source phrase and an explicit provision object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the denied wanting is not abstract but aimed at a specific rejected relation: provision from the created group.
topics.reason: The first verb takes the source phrase and the provision noun as its local argument frame, with the provision noun functioning as semantic object under the particle construction.

topics.headline: volition with pursuit pressure
topics.summary: Root-family pursuit pressure survives as image, while local Form IV selects wanting and willing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that the denial reaches behind external seeking to the inner volitional impulse itself.
topics.reason: V4 supports will and directed seeking within the root family, but the local Form IV verb and complement frame select volition rather than activating separate solicitation or motion branches as local senses.

topics.headline: Form IV initiation of will
topics.summary: The chosen form places the denial at the level of intention before pursuit or acquisition.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording denies the start of wanting itself before any act of seeking provision could arise.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form IV, and the dictionary guardrail licenses will and intention for this root while keeping broader motion branches separate.

topics.headline: repeated verb backbone
topics.summary: The first verb anticipates the exact reprise that organizes both halves of the ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one verbal nucleus governing two denied domains rather than two unrelated statements.
topics.reason: The second same-form verb is coordinated with the first, and both are in matching negated clauses.

topics.headline: purpose boundary shift
topics.summary: The verse moves from the creation-purpose statement in 51:56 to a negated divine will in 51:57.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 51:57 defines what the purpose of creation is not after 51:56 states what it is.
topics.reason: The prior first-person creation statement in 51:56 is followed by first-person negated wanting clauses in 51:57.

words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) pulls the created pair from 51:56 into this ayah through the attached plural suffix. The word marks the rejected source before the provision noun appears, so the first clause foregrounds the relation from them before naming what is denied. Its first {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) works differently from the following {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}): this one points to source and antecedent, while the next one helps universalize the object. Across the ayah the same group shifts from possible source in {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) to possible agents in {{ar:يُطْعِمُونِ}} ({{tr:yut'imuni}}), and both roles are rejected.

topics.headline: antecedent from 51:56
topics.summary: The suffix resumes the created group named in the previous ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the denied provision relation to the very beings just described as created for worship in 51:56.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the suffix to the created plural pair in 51:56.

topics.headline: source before object
topics.summary: The phrase marks the rejected source before the provision noun is introduced.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause first rules out the created group as source before it names provision itself.
topics.reason: The phrase is attached as a source complement to the first wanting verb and precedes the negated object phrase.

topics.headline: two nearby particle functions
topics.summary: The first particle marks source while the second handles universalizing scope.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not collapse the adjacent particles into one job; one carries source and pronoun, the other shapes the denied object.
topics.reason: The first occurrence is fused with a pronoun suffix, while the second governs the indefinite provision noun in the negated object construction.

topics.headline: source to agent shift
topics.summary: The created group is rejected first as source of provision and later as agents of feeding.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that dependency on creation is denied across different grammatical roles, not only in one phrase.
topics.reason: The same antecedent group is source in the first clause and the implicit 3mp subject of the final feeding verb.

words.gloss_range: governing particle before an indefinite noun under negation, functioning as universalizing reinforcement: not any provision

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite provision governed by the particle

words.prose: The second {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is small but decisive. It still governs {{ar:رِزْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:rizqin}}) as a preposition, yet in the negative construction it presses the object from provision in general into any provision at all. Because it stands right after {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}), the repeated particle creates a tight source-and-scope sequence: from them, not any provision. That scope protects the previous ayah's worship purpose in 51:56 from being misread as material service to God.

topics.headline: universal negative scope
topics.summary: The particle before the indefinite noun universalizes the negated object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording denies any provision whatsoever, not merely a specific kind of provision.
topics.reason: The particle governs an indefinite provision noun under negation, and the translation support identifies it as the reinforced negative construction.

topics.headline: governing particle not empty
topics.summary: Even with reinforced negative force, the particle still governs the following genitive noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the universal force works through visible grammar, not through a disposable filler word.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the particle as governing the following noun while translation support warns against lexicalizing it as a second source phrase.

topics.headline: adjacent particle split
topics.summary: The adjacent particles repeat sound while separating source and quantifying scope.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears source, scope, and indefinite object bound into one continuous denial while keeping their functions distinct.
topics.reason: The first particle belongs to the source phrase and the second governs the indefinite object, so the echo is real without making the functions identical.

topics.headline: purpose is not provisioning
topics.summary: The particle helps exclude a provisioning reading of the worship purpose from 51:56.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that creation's worship purpose in 51:56 is not a channel for supplying God.
topics.reason: The negative-scope particle sits in the first denial immediately after the purpose statement of 51:56.

words.root_gloss_range: provision, allotted share, sustenance, and provider-related roles; local usage denies God as recipient and anticipates God as Provider in 51:58

words.prose: {{ar:رِزْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:rizqin}}) closes the first denial with the thing refused: provision as an unbounded category. Its genitive surface comes from {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}), but its role remains the semantic object of {{ar:أُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:uridu}}), so the clause denies wanting provision from the created group. The indefiniteness and tanwin keep the object open-ended: not any share, allotment, livelihood, or supplied resource. The root thread then turns sharply outward: this denied {{ar:رِزْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:rizqin}}) recalls provision in 51:22 and is answered by the Provider title in 51:58, making provision flow from God to creation, not creation to God. Paired with {{ar:يُطْعِمُونِ}} ({{tr:yut'imuni}}), it gives the ayah product first and process second.

topics.headline: indefinite universal provision
topics.summary: The indefinite noun under negation denies any instance of provision.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that no kind, quantity, or quality of provision is being sought from creation.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite, governed by the negative-scope particle, and marked as the object of the denied desire.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps case form and event role distinct: provision is governed by the particle but still names what is not wanted.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks both particle governance and semantic object status for the noun.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the first denial covers supplied resources broadly before the ayah narrows into the bodily act of feeding.
topics.reason: Dictionary evidence includes provision and nourishment branches, but the separate feeding verb in the second clause keeps the local noun from being reduced to food alone.

topics.summary: The grammar raises God as possible recipient of provision only to negate that role.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a marked reversal: the familiar provision root is used to deny God as recipient rather than to show God giving.
topics.reason: The local first-person negation makes the divine speaker the one from whom recipienthood is denied, which is marked against the root's common provider frame.

topics.headline: surah provision thread
topics.summary: The word links backward to 51:22 and forward to the Provider title in 51:58.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same surah thread establish a one-way channel: provision is for creation from above in 51:22 and not from creation to God in 51:57.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references, and the local root form supports provision as the shared lexical field.

topics.headline: Provider title forward answer
topics.summary: The next ayah answers the denied provision noun with the intensive Provider title.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 51:58 supplies the positive role after 51:57 removes God from recipienthood: God is Provider, not provided-for.
topics.reason: The next ayah uses the same root in an intensive provider title, making the directional reversal explicit.

topics.headline: product then process
topics.summary: The provision noun is paired with the later feeding verb as product and process.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah deny both the supplied resource and the embodied act of supplying it.
topics.reason: The first clause closes on a provision noun, while the coordinated second clause expands into a feeding action.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins a complete first denial to a second complete denial. It is not just an added word; it hinges the ayah from {{ar:رِزْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:rizqin}}), the provision product, into the later action {{ar:يُطْعِمُونِ}} ({{tr:yut'imuni}}), the feeding process. Because it is prefixed directly to the second {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:ma}}), the second negation remains attached to the first rather than floating as a new topic. The result is cumulative: neither the thing supplied nor the act of supplying it is wanted.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second denial is coordinated with the first, not detached from it.

Its scope runs through {{ar:يُطْعِمُونِ}} ({{tr:yut'imuni}}), so the denied object is no longer only a noun but a whole feeding scenario. Because this {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:ma}}) mirrors the opening {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:ma}}), the second half feels like a deliberate extension of the first. The added {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) onset lets the rhythm repeat while marking the clause as coordinated.

words.prose: The second {{ar:أُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:uridu}}) repeats the same first-person imperfect Form IV verb, so the second half keeps the same negated volitional nucleus as the first. What changes is the governed material: instead of pointing to {{ar:رِزْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:rizqin}}), it takes the explicit clause {{ar:أَنْ يُطْعِمُونِ}} ({{tr:an yut'imuni}}). That makes the denial grow from a provision object to a whole event in which they would feed the speaker. The pursuit pressure of {{ar:ر و د}} ({{tr:r-w-d}}) remains image-level here; local grammar selects wanting and directs it toward an action scenario only to negate it. This also clarifies the movement from 51:56: creation is for worship, not for feeding the Creator.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human feeding can be virtuous elsewhere (76:9), but creation's purpose here is not to feed God.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL evidence gives 76:9 as a contrast, while the local clause negates feeding God as an object of divine desire.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) is the doorway into the second complement. It tells the reader that {{ar:أُرِيدُ}} ({{tr:uridu}}) now points not to another noun but to the following verb, {{ar:يُطْعِمُونِ}} ({{tr:yut'imuni}}). By governing that verb as subjunctive, it keeps the feeding in an unrealized, subordinated space: the ayah is not reporting that they feed or do not feed, but denying wanting the scenario that they should feed. At the same time, the clause can function like the object of wanting while preserving visible verbal agency, and its nasal close binds audibly into the governed verb at the clause boundary.

words.prose: {{ar:يُطْعِمُونِ}} ({{tr:yut'imuni}}) is where the second denial lands. Form IV makes the verb causative: the imagined relation is not that they eat, but that they feed or cause the speaker to eat. Its plural subject carries the created group from 51:56, and the first-person suffix makes the divine speaker the grammatical object; the ayah stages that patient role only to reject it. Because {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) governs the verb, the feeding remains a subjunctive, unrealized scenario inside negated wanting. The {{ar:ط ع م}} ({{tr:ṭ-ʿ-m}}) field gives the denial embodied force through food, taste, and feeding, while local grammar selects causative feeding. As the final word, it closes on the concrete act of feeding God, with recitation pressure between clipped {{ar:يُطْعِمُونْ}} ({{tr:yut'imun}}) and fuller {{ar:يُطْعِمُونِي}} ({{tr:yut'imuni}}) closure keeping the first-person object audible at the ending. The word also echoes the principle that God feeds and is not fed (6:14) and contrasts human ethical feeding scenes such as 76:8-9 where creatures may feed needy recipients, not the Creator.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated negated volition at words 2 and 7 governs both provision at word 5 and feeding at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first object names an allotted resource; the second names another's act of feeding. Their parallel negation rejects both tribute transferred from creatures and creature-performed maintenance.

activation_trace.role: Contributes intending and willing, making the doubled clauses refusals of desire rather than reports of nonreceipt.
Contributes an allotted gift or share and supplies the resource-transfer side of the denied relation.
Contributes feeding another and supplies the denied service side of the relation.

changed_reading.before: The speaker merely says that he does not want food.
changed_reading.after: The double clause rejects both an allotted contribution and the act of being maintained by creature service.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Provision at word 5 is followed by the causative feeding action at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired terms span stored or assigned sustenance, its delivery, and its consumption. The denial therefore closes an entire nourishment chain rather than repeating one appetite in two synonyms.

activation_trace.role: Contributes ingestible sustenance and defines the material that would maintain a recipient.

changed_reading.before: Provision and feeding restate the same food request.
changed_reading.after: Provision names the supply while feeding names its conversion into maintenance, and both stages are denied.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated volition root governs the action that the creatures would perform.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of volition involves pressing another toward an act against a competing will. Negating that relation rules out bargaining with or conscripting creatures into the role of feeders.

activation_trace.role: Contributes solicitation amid competing wills and exposes the social pressure explicitly negated here.
Contributes the act of feeding another as the service into which creatures are not being recruited.

changed_reading.before: No food is requested from them.
changed_reading.after: No pressure or negotiation recruits them into a provider role for the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation fixes the direction of dependence and worship fixes the creatures' responsive role; the immediate denial then prevents that service from being construed as replenishing or maintaining the creator.

activation_trace.role: Makes the two denials explicit refusals to desire maintenance from the addressed creatures.
Supplies the allotted contribution whose upward transfer is denied.
Supplies the creature-performed feeding service that is denied as worship's function.
Contributes origination of created beings and fixes the creator-to-creature direction of dependence.
Contributes submissive worship as the purpose-side relation that 51:57 strips of a provisioning function.

structural_cues: 51:56 states the created purpose immediately before the doubled first-person denial in 51:57.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, worship, provision, and feeding; I infer from their adjacency that the denial excludes a maintenance rationale for worship. A live alternative is that 51:57 rebuts only one imagined rationale without exhausting worship's purposes.

changed_reading.before: The speaker declines provision and feeding as isolated requests.
changed_reading.after: Worship is creature-side obedience, not a maintenance economy in which servants replenish their creator.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reminder immediately preceding the creation-purpose sequence is said to benefit believers, while the focus denies any resource or nourishment moving back from them. This relocates practical gain to the addressed recipients.

activation_trace.role: Contributes seeking and marks what the speaker does not pursue from the addressees.
Contributes the transferable benefit explicitly excluded from the speaker's side.
Contributes beneficiary-directed feeding and sharpens the denied return flow.
Contributes benefit rather than harm and locates positive effect on the reminder's recipients.

structural_cues: 51:55 grammatically assigns benefit to believers, and 51:56-57 follows without a change in exhortative setting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recipient benefit followed by denied return provision; I infer a directional contrast in which the summons serves the hearers rather than enriching the speaker. Alternatively, the benefit may belong narrowly to reminder uptake, not to the whole worship relation.

changed_reading.before: The denial only establishes that the speaker takes no food payment.
changed_reading.after: The denial helps identify the addressees, not the speaker, as beneficiaries of the summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah identifies the divine side as the active source of allotment and pairs that role with gathered strength and enduring solidity. The focus denial becomes a categorical reversal of economic direction, not modest refusal.

activation_trace.role: Marks the allotted transfer that cannot originate with the creatures toward the speaker.

Contributes extended solidity and stabilizes the provider role against any need for replenishment.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply refuses a contribution from creatures.
changed_reading.after: The refused upward supply is followed by a full downward measure, making the focus a reversal point in the direction of filling.

strongest_changes: 51:56 turns the denial into a guardrail: worship is obedience, not provisioning the creator.
51:58 converts modest refusal into provider-side asymmetry grounded in strength and firmness.
51:59 extends the allotment register from denied upward tribute to matched downward consequence.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled focus negation closes both the resource and service channels; the split-root support image and the later full-measure branch preserve material readings that a conservative synthesis could lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The beneficiary-direction reading depends on discourse adjacency and may apply more narrowly to reminder uptake.
The supporting-prop activation is deliberately form-distant and should remain secondary.
The allotment echo in 51:59 may be rhetorical juxtaposition rather than a unified distributive mechanism.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Purpose is severed from divine need.** Repeated `ر و د/B001` supplies will/intention; `ر ز ق/B001-2` provision/food; `ط ع م/B002` feeding another. The parallel negations deny both demanded allotment and nourishment. I infer **creation for worship does not imply resource extraction from creatures**. The verse blocks a transactional misreading of 51:56.
2. **The provisioning direction is one-way at the divine-creature level.** Earlier, creatures receive sky-provision (51:22) and humans hold others' due in wealth (51:19). Here the reverse direction is denied. I infer **divine provision -> creature; creature feeding -> other creature, not Provider**. `ر ز ق` and `ط ع م` perform distinct allotment and ingestion roles.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:58 supplies the positive reversal to both negations: provision flows from the strong Provider rather than upward from dependent creatures.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Purpose is severed from resource extraction.** **Lexical evidence:** repeated fixed `ر و د/B001` is will and intention; fixed `ر ز ق/B001` is “provision as an allotted gift”; fixed `ط ع م/B002` is feeding and asking for food. **Structural cue:** messenger-rejection, overflow, reoriented reminder, and creation for worship occupy 51:52–56; 51:58 reverses the imagined flow by naming God the Provider with strength, and 51:59–60 assign consequence and a promised day. **Role and abduction:** the repeated negation blocks both receiving an allotment and being fed, while the next ayah identifies the actual supplying source; I infer that worship cannot be construed as payment for divine need. **Reading change:** the ayah dismantles a transactional model in which creatures sustain the one they serve.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:58’s emphatic Provider-title supplied the explicit reversal: provision flows from, rather than toward, the one whose purpose was stated.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hem bir şeyin ya da kişinin önceki yerine veya durumuna dönmesini hem de onun oraya döndürülmesini açıkça ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Görmenin yeniden kazanılması bu çekirdeğin bir durumun geri gelmesi biçimindeki özel gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek dönüş ve geri döndürmedir; yalnızca engelleme, reddetme, ticari geri alma veya yineleme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dönüş çekirdeğini korur; yön bildiren, yetki devreden ve belirli bir durumun geri gelmesini anlatan yapılar ayrı özel kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin veya kişinin önceki yerine, sahibine ya da durumuna dönmesi yahut bir etken tarafından oraya döndürülmesidir. Kaybolmuş bir işlevin yeniden kazanılması da aynı geri gelme düzeninin özel bir görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Hareketin temel yönü, bir varlığın daha önce bulunduğu yere veya duruma geri gelmesidir.
Geçişli kullanımda bir etken, şeyi yerine, sahibine veya bağlı olduğu merciye geri gönderir.
Bir yetinin yeniden ortaya çıkması, önceki durumun geri kazanılması olarak kavranır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortaklaştırılmış anlatımı, kendiliğinden geri gelme ile bir şeyi geri gönderme biçimlerini tek dönüş çekirdeğinde birleştirir; yer, sahip, merci ve önceki işlev bu yönün farklı hedefleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi kabul etmeme, sözü yanlış sayma ve sahte olduğu anlaşılan parayı geri çevirme kullanımlarını açıkça bir araya getirir. Dal çerçevesi, geri göndermeyi tek başına değil olumsuz değerlendirme sonucuna bağlı olarak sunar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirleyici unsur kabul etmeme veya geçersiz saymadır; yalnızca geri gönderme ya da zarar savuşturma yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, bir şeyi kişiye karşı geri çeviren veya sahte parayı geri veren yapılara bağlıdır; yalın kök için genel reddetme anlamı kurulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sunulan bir şeyi kabul etmeyip sahibine geri çevirmek veya bir söz ya da iddiayı yanlış ve geçersiz saymaktır. Daha önce alınmış sahte paranın denetleyene geri verilmesi bu değerlendirmenin somut ticari örneğidir.

facets.statement: Nesne, söz veya iddia olumsuz değerlendirme sonucunda kabul edilmez.
Bir sözü yanlış saymak, kabul etmemenin doğruluk değerlendirmesine uygulanmış biçimidir.
Sahte olduğu belirlenen paranın onu denetleyene geri verilmesi, kabul etmemenin ticari örneğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Söz veya kanıt bağlamında her iki dal da ileri sürülen şeyin geçerli kabul edilmemesi sonucuna varır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal değerlendiren kişinin kabul etmeme eylemini anlatırken komşu dal kanıtın dayanağının ortadan kalkması veya çürütülmesi sonucunu öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Burada kabul veya doğruluk hakkında olumsuz bir hüküm vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda kişi ya da etki yönünden çevrilir veya hedefe ulaşması engellenir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir şey amaçlanan kabul ya da sonuca erişemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi bir malın geri verilmesini istemeyi veya onu geri almayı, ayrıca bozulan satışta iki tarafın aldıklarını karşılıklı vermesini açıkça kapsar. Dalın ticari ve karşılıklı sınırı kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, geri isteme ve satışın bozulmasında karşılıklı iade ile sınırlıdır; sıradan dönüş veya yeni bir satış işlemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca geri isteme, malı geri alma ve satış taraflarının karşılıklı iadesini bildiren yapılara uygulanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kendisine geri verilmesini istemek veya verilmiş malı geri almak; bozulan bir satışta da tarafların aldıklarını birbirine geri vererek işlemi çözmesidir.

facets.statement: Önceden verilmiş ya da el değiştirmiş bir şey geri istenir veya geri alınır.
Satış bozulduğunda iki taraf da aldığı şeyi ötekine geri verir ve değişim tersine çevrilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, tek taraflı geri isteme ve geri alma ile satışın bozulmasındaki karşılıklı iadeyi aynı geri kazanma düzeninde birleştirir; ticari kullanımda her taraf eline geçeni geri verir.

concept_gloss.text: geri isteme veya karşılıklı geri verme

error_profile.preserves: Geri isteme, geri alma ve iki taraflı iade yoluyla işlemi çözme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin daha önce verdiği veya elinden çıkardığı malı yeniden edindiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceden el değiştirmiş malı geri kazanma işlemini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Alıcı ile satıcının aldıklarını birbirine geri vererek satışı çözdüğü bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki taraflı geri verme ile satışın çözülmesi arasındaki bağı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal önceki satışı karşılıklı iadeyle tersine çevirir; komşu dal ise yeni bir satın alma ya da satış getirisiyle devam eden farklı bir işlemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geri isteme ile ticari işlemin karşılıklı iade yoluyla çözülmesini şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir şeyin önceki yere, sahibine veya duruma dönmesini genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir nesne daha önceki sahibine veya konumuna geri gider.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Genel geri dönüş, talep ya da satış ilişkisi gerektirmez; bu dal ise geri kazanma iradesi veya iki taraflı ticari çözme yapısına bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi bu dalda Müslüman olduktan sonra inancı bırakıp inkâra dönmeyi açıkça belirtir. Bununla birlikte aynı türemiş biçimin din dışı geri dönüşlerde de kullanılabildiği ayrıca bildirildiği için dal kimliği yalnızca din ve inkâr açık olduğunda geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Özel adlandırma inkâra dönüşle sınırlıdır; genel geri dönüş anlamı ve başka tür din değişiklikleri kendiliğinden bu dala alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın olmayan adlar ve din bildiren yapı birlikte korunur; genel geri dönüş bildiren aynı biçim bu dinî dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İslam dinini benimsedikten sonra ondan ayrılıp inkâr durumuna dönmektir. Dal, bu eylemi ve onu gerçekleştiren kişiyi adlandıran dinle sınırlı biçimleri kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişi daha önce benimsediği İslam dininden ayrılarak inkâr durumuna döner.
Özel eylem adı yalnızca bu dinî inkâra dönüş için kullanılır.
Dönüş bildiren daha genel eylem adı başka alanlarda da geçebilir; burada ancak din açıkça belirtilirse bu dala bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, eylemi önceki inanç durumuna göre yön değiştirme olarak açıklar ve özel eylem adını inkâra dönüşe bağlar; daha genel dönüş adı ise bağlama göre din dışına taşabilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin Müslüman olduktan sonra dinini bırakıp inkâr durumuna geçtiğinin açıkça belirtildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki İslam bağlılığını, sonradan ayrılmayı ve inkâr durumuna geçişi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Önceki İslam bağlılığı bağlamdan biliniyor ve sonraki inkâr durumu vurgulanıyorsa kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî bağlılığın bırakılmasını ve inkâra yönelişi açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iman ettikten sonra yeniden inkâr durumuna döndürmek

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi boşanmış ve ailesine geri gönderilmiş kadını temel adlandırma olarak verir; kızın yeniden babasının geçimine bağımlı olması da bu durumun açıklayıcı örneğidir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu katılımcı ve durum sınırını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu ad yalnızca boşanıp ailesine geri gönderilen kadını belirtir; her boşanmış kişi veya ailesine dönen her kadın kapsamda değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kanıtta ad olarak verilen boşanmış ve ailesine dönmüş kadın anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yapı bağımlı başka bir okuma eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Boşandıktan sonra ailesine, özellikle baba evine geri gönderilen kadındır. Başka geçim sağlayanı bulunmayan kızın yeniden babasının bakımına girmesi bunun açıklayıcı bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Kadın boşanmış ve eşinin yanından ailesine geri gönderilmiştir.
Ailesine dönüş, geçimini sağlayan başka bir kimse olmadığında yeniden baba bakımına girme sonucunu doğurabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım adlandırmayı boşanmış kadının ailesine geri gönderilmesine bağlar; yeniden babanın geçimine bağlı kalan kız örneği bu toplumsal ve ekonomik sonucu açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Boşanma sonrasında ailesine geri gönderilen kadın için kullanılır; geçim bağımlılığı yalnızca açıklayıcı örnek bağlamında eşlik edebilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kadını, boşanmayı ve aileye geri gönderilmeyi korur; geçim bağımlılığını zorunlu koşul yapmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özellikle kızın boşanma sonrası babasının evine ve bakımına döndüğü aile bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Boşanma sonrasında baba evine ve aile bakımına geri dönme durumunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Toplu kaynak ifadesi hayvan memesinin sütle dolması ile ırmak veya denizde su ya da dalga bolluğunu açıkça aynı dalda toplar. Uzun süre eşsiz kalan erkek kullanımı ise doğrudan genel su birikimi değil, yoğun cinsel istek ve bedensel sıvı birikimiyle açıklanan ayrı bir özel kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıvı doluluğu ve bolluğu eksenindedir; erkekle ilgili kullanım bu eksenin özel bedensel uzantısı olarak ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hayvan, su kütlesi ve erkek bildiren bağlı kullanımlar ayrıştırılır; bunların özellikleri yalın kökün genel anlamıymış gibi birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Sütün bir hayvanın memesinde dolması veya suyun bir ırmak ya da denizde çok ve dalgalı olmasıdır. Uzun süre eşsiz kalan erkeğin bedensel sıvı birikimiyle yoğun istek duyması bunun özel ve kişiye bağlı uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yerde sıvı doluluğu veya belirgin sıvı bolluğu oluşur.
Doğumdan önce hayvan memesinin sütle dolması, çekirdeğin hayvancılığa özgü gerçekleşmesidir.
Irmakta suyun veya denizde su ve dalganın çokluğu, doluluk çekirdeğinin doğal çevreye uzanmasıdır.
Uzun süre eşsiz kalan erkekte birikim ve yoğun cinsel istek birlikte anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım sütle dolu meme ile bol sulu veya çok dalgalı su kütlesini doluluk ekseninde birleştirir; uzun eşsizlik sonucu yoğun istek duyan erkek bu sıvı birikimi tasarımına bağlı özel kullanımdır.

concept_gloss.text: sütün, suyun veya bedensel sıvının birikip çoğalması
concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvan memesindeki süt doluluğu, su kütlesindeki bolluk ve erkeğe bağlı özel birikim kullanımlarını birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Sıvı birikimini, miktar artışını ve hayvan, çevre ile insan bağlamlarındaki ayrımı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Koyun veya devenin doğum öncesinde memesinin sütle dolduğu hayvancılık bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan memesindeki süt doluluğunu ve doğum öncesi durumu korur.

Bu nedenle dal genel bir yalın anlam gibi değil, kanıtlanan kullanımlarla sınırlı olarak tanımlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yapılan iyiliğin kendisi değildir; iyiliğe verilmesi beklenen olumlu karşılık veya bunun yalanlamayla değiştirilmesidir.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir yöresel kullanımda, kendisine yapılan iyiliği kabul edip buna olumlu karşılık vermeyi anlatır. Belirli bir söz öbeğinde ise verilen iyiliğe karşılık gelmesi gereken bu tutumun yalanlama ile değiştirilmesi eleştirilir.

facets.statement: Kişi kendisine yapılan iyiliği kabul eder ve bunu olumlu bir karşılıkla dışa vurur.
Bu anlam belirli bir topluluğa ait yöresel sözlüksel kullanımla sınırlıdır.
Kanıtlı söz öbeği, iyiliğe olumlu karşılık vermek yerine onu yalanlamayı ya da payı yanlışlığa çevirmeyi anlatır.
